decisions.reason: The service remains central to the firm's data centre and cloud direction, with heavy sunk investment and visible customer adoption, so temporary industry weakness does not justify withdrawal.

Although the portal is peripheral to the announced software-defined direction, prior investment and public commitment still lead management to persist while poor results can be attributed to the industry downturn.

This legacy telephony service is peripheral and its disappointing results reflect a structural decline in carrier pre-selection rather than a temporary downturn, so despite sunk costs the firm drops it.
Similarly, the direct voice connection is not central to the future direction and its sustained poor performance can no longer be attributed only to temporary conditions, so management withdraws it.
